description: Change control for a GMP-regulated Life Science company in 8 phases: Registration → Coordination → Planning (quick or extended analysis) → Manager approval → QA approval → Implementation → Follow-up → Closure. Product/supplier fields hidden unless relevant, GxP/EHS assessment, activities as sub cases, e-signatures at every approval and at closure.

phases.name: Registration
phases.description: The initiator describes the change, its purpose and trigger, what is affected (premises, equipment, IT, product, supplier) and assigns the change leader (button sends e-mail).

phases.name: Coordination
phases.description: The change leader justifies the change, assesses GxP and EHS impact, classifies it and assigns manager and QA approvers. If the case is not to be carried out it goes directly to Manager approval.

rules.condition: Shall the case be carried out? = No

phases.name: Planning
phases.description: Quick or extended analysis (impact, solution, activities, risks, conclusion), activities as sub cases. On forward: e-mail to the manager approver.

phases.name: Manager approval
phases.description: The manager approves or rejects with justification; more information → backward. E-signature on forward.

rules.condition: Backward and the case is not to be carried out

rules.subject: Change [ID] sent back by the manager

phases.name: QA approval
phases.description: QA approves (forward), rejects (quick close) or sends back to Planning. E-signature on forward and quick close.

rules.condition: Shall the change be carried out? = No
Backward and the case is not to be carried out

phases.name: Implementation
phases.description: The change leader carries out the activities and documents implementation and implementation date.

phases.name: Follow-up
phases.description: Follow-up of effect and GMP documentation. E-signature on forward; e-mail to the manager approver.

rules.subject: Change [ID] followed up – ready for closure

phases.name: Closure
phases.description: The manager signs off the change (e-signature). If completion is needed: comment and send backward to the change leader.

notes:
Reference configuration EX-26755 (Workflow – Ändringsärende (CC) – Life Science, Pharma), translated to English.

Rules in the original: product/supplier fields hidden unless the Yes/No field = Yes (all phases); integration result hidden for all but admin; web service call for article number; in Coordination the fields shown/mandatory depend on 'Shall the case be carried out?' and the case goes directly to Manager approval when No; in Planning the fields depend on analysis level (quick/extended); hidden mandatory checkboxes force direction at approvals; flow changes: Manager/QA backward → Coordination when the case is not to be carried out, QA/Implementation backward → Planning; e-signature on forward from Manager approval, QA approval (also quick close), Follow-up and Closure.
